title: ★2026-2학기 설강교과목 담당교원 변경 [인공지능창의설계, 인공지능프로그래밍(2분반)]★

summary: 2026학년도 2학기 설강 교과목 중 인공지능창의설계, 인공지능프로그래밍(2분반)의 담당교원이 변경됨
인공지능프로그래밍(2분반, AIE2002-002) 담당교원: 이필현 → 김병형으로 변경
analysis.easyExplanation: 2026학년도 2학기에 개설되는 인공지능창의설계와 인공지능프로그래밍(2분반) 두 과목의 담당 교수님이 바뀌었어요. 해당 과목을 수강하는 학생은 변경된 교원 정보를 확인하면 되고, 개강 첫 주는 휴강이니 참고하세요.

en.title: ★Change of Instructor for 2026-2nd Semester Courses [AI Creative Design, AI Programming (Section 2)]★
summary: The instructor for two courses offered in the 2026 second semester, 'AI Creative Design' and 'AI Programming (Section 2)', has been changed
AI Creative Design (AIE1004-001) instructor: changed from Sang-seon Lee to Byeong-hyeong Kim
AI Programming Section 2 (AIE2002-002) instructor: changed from Pil-hyeon Lee to Byeong-hyeong Kim
Classes will be suspended in the first week of the semester
en.easyExplanation: The instructors for two 2026 second-semester courses, AI Creative Design and AI Programming (Section 2), have changed. Students enrolled in these courses should check the updated instructor information, and note that there will be no class in the first week of the semester.
en.target: Students enrolled in 'AI Creative Design (AIE1004-001)' and 'AI Programming (Section 2, AIE2002-002)' for the 2026 second semester
